meta.prompt_source: 用户提供题面：英语二大作文（图表：某高校学生每月参加志愿服务次数占比，要求描述图表并发表评论，约150词）

band.rationale: 对照第四档描述“较好地完成了试题规定的任务”“包含所有内容要点”“层次清晰”“对目标读者产生了预期的效果”：图表三个数据点（35%、45%、20%）齐全且准确，描述与评论双任务均完成，三段式组织清楚，故定为第四档；但 percent/percentage 混用、主谓一致、单复数等基础错误密度偏高，未达到“语言基本准确……个别错误”的理想状态，故取本档最低位。

dimensions.name: 切题与图表解读
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三个数据点全部覆盖且数值准确，描述与评论双任务均完成；扣分因描述止于数据罗列，缺少一句对整体分布的概括（如大多数学生参与频率偏低）。

dimensions.name: 内容展开与评论
dimensions.evidence: Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 给出两条原因并附建议，方向合理，但每条原因仅一个分句、未做展开，评论部分建议笼统，缺少具体措施或例证。

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 描述—原因—建议三段结构与题面要求对应，Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion 衔接有效；但本句用逗号连接两个独立分句（粘连句），段落内部推进较平。

dimensions.name: 语法与句式控制
dimensions.evidence: In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 全篇约六处硬伤：does not provides（助动词后应接原形）、activities is（主谓一致）、learn skill / make friend（可数名词单复数）、the the（相邻重复）、逗号粘连句；末句 Only in this way can we 倒装使用正确，是本段亮点。

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.evidence: There are many reasons for this phenomonon.
dimensions.deduction_reason: “百分之35”误用名词 percentage 且全篇反复三次（应为 percent）；phenomonon 拼写错误；话题词汇（volunteer activities、take part in、balance）基本够用但范围有限。

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 首段直接入题，三段分段规范，无空白、乱码或格式标记问题（以预检事实为准）。

consistency.adjustments: 初评切题 4.5、内容展开 2，维度合计 10.5；复核后认为图表描述缺少整体趋势概括、两条原因均未展开，分别调至 4 与 1.5，维度合计 10，落入第四档区间 [10,12]，与档位自洽。

sentence_edits.original: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.
sentence_edits.issue: the situation of 表意笼统；图表作文首句直接点明“参与频率/比例”更清晰。此为可选的更贴切表达，不作为扣分依据。
sentence_edits.revised: The chart shows how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities.

sentence_edits.original: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month.
sentence_edits.issue: percentage 是名词，“百分之35”应用 35 percent，此错误全篇反复出现；“take part in one to two times every month”中介词与频率状语叠用，搭配生硬。
sentence_edits.revised: 35 percent of the students never take part in volunteer activities, while 45 percent of them participate once or twice a month.

sentence_edits.original: Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
sentence_edits.issue: 20 percentage students 缺少介词 of，应为 20 percent of students；句式与上句保持“percent of + 名词”结构。
sentence_edits.revised: Only 20 percent of students take part three times or more every month.

sentence_edits.original: There are many reasons for this phenomonon.
sentence_edits.issue: phenomonon 拼写错误，正确拼写为 phenomenon。
sentence_edits.revised: There are many reasons for this phenomenon.

sentence_edits.original: Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library.
sentence_edits.issue: study 表“学习”这一行为时，用 studying 或 their studies 更自然。属可选润色，不作为扣分依据。
sentence_edits.revised: Firstly, some students think that studying is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library.

sentence_edits.original: Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
sentence_edits.issue: 助动词 does not 后应接动词原形 provide；逗号不能连接两个独立句子，需补连词 so 体现因果关系。
sentence_edits.revised: Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about volunteer activities, so many students do not know how to join.

sentence_edits.original: In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
sentence_edits.issue: 主语 activities 为复数，谓语应用 are，主谓不一致。
sentence_edits.revised: In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students.

sentence_edits.original: It can help us learn skill and make friend.
sentence_edits.issue: skill 与 friend 均为可数名词，此处应用复数 skills、friends；主语 It 与上句复数主语 activities 指代不一致。
sentence_edits.revised: They can help us learn new skills and make friends.

sentence_edits.original: The school should offer more chances and students should balance the the study and volunteer work.
sentence_edits.issue: the the 相邻重复（预检脚本亦标记）；balance 的宾语不需定冠词，应为 balance their studies and volunteer work；两个并列分句之间宜加逗号。
sentence_edits.revised: The school should offer more chances, and students should balance their studies and volunteer work.

improved_version:
The chart shows how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities. 35 percent of the students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percent of them participate once or twice a month. Only 20 percent of students take part three times or more.

There are many reasons for this phenomenon. Firstly, some students think that studying is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library. Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about these activities, so many students do not know how to join.

In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students. They can help us learn new skills and make friends. Therefore, the school should offer more chances, and students should balance their studies and volunteer work. Only in this way can we grow up better.
top_problems: percent 与 percentage 混用且贯穿全篇三次——数据转写是英语二图表作文的核心任务，此错误反复出现最直接拉低词汇维度得分
基础语法错误密度偏高：does not provides、activities is、learn skill and make friend、the the、逗号粘连，几乎每段都有，压制语法维度
原因与评论展开不足：两条原因各仅一个分句，建议部分笼统，限制内容展开维度的上限
practice_advice: 做“图表数据三句转写”限时练习：任取一组百分比数据，用三句写完（总起一句+两个对比一句），规定自己每处比例一律写 percent 并检查 percent of + 复数名词；写完逐句回读，专查主谓一致和可数名词单复数，坚持两周即可覆盖本篇绝大多数失分点。

patterns: The chart shows how often ... take part in ...
X percent of ... , while Y percent of ...
There are many reasons for this phenomenon. Firstly, ... Secondly, ...
Only in this way can we ...
words: take part in / participate in volunteer activities
